summary: Arkansas Forestry Commission lookout about a mile east of Atlanta, Columbia County; a 1941 federal survey describes an all-steel tower about 100 feet high with an enclosed cab.

facts.design: All-steel tower with an enclosed cabin at the top
facts.status_note: No source found says whether the tower still stands

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey described the tower in 1941, so it was standing by then

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts describes it as an Arkansas Forestry Commission lookout
evidence.quote: THIS STATION IS A LOOKOUT TOWER OF THE ARKANSAS FORESTRY

evidence.supports: about 1 mile east of Atlanta, on high ground
evidence.quote: COMMISSION, LOCATED ABOUT 1 MILE EAST OF ATLANTA, ON HIGH
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1941 (KBJ)

evidence.supports: all-steel construction, enclosed cabin at top, about 100 feet high
evidence.quote: THE TOWER IS OF ALL STEEL CONSTRUCTION, WITH AN ENCLOSED CABIN AT THE TOP AND IS ABOUT 100 FEET HIGH.

evidence.supports: about 1,200 feet northeast of the center of Section 1, T19N R19W
evidence.quote: GROUND, ABOUT 1200 FEET NORTHEAST OF THE CENTER OF SEC. 1, T 19 N, R 19 W.

evidence.supports: Commission set up by Act 234 in 1931 and built many more towers
evidence.quote: The Arkansas Forestry Commission was established by Act 234 in 1931, and it too built many more towers.

evidence.supports: tower watchmen scanned the forests for smoke during daylight
evidence.quote: Tower watchmen often lived alone in or near the tower and spent the daylight hours scanning the forests for signs of smoke.

evidence.supports: station DL1476 published position 33 06 46 N, 093 01 54 W

notes_for_editor: Sources: the Forest Lookouts page (which reproduces the 1941 Coast and Geodetic Survey description), the NGS station record DL1476, and the Encyclopedia of Arkansas for agency and watchmen context. No source gives a build date, staffing, fires, status or access. The 1941 description is the only dated event. height_m 30.5 is the brief's value; it converts the survey's 'about 100 feet' and is not a measurement. Brief checks: county, agency and coordinates (33.1129, -93.0317 agree with DL1476 to rounding); no corrections. The Arkansas index page calls it 'ATLANTA #88'.
